reuse.why: The change reuses budget, averaging, batching and undo helpers, but introduces custom tag parsing despite the existing extractTagsFromText helper.

duplication.why: Average actions are consolidated, but category eligibility is expressed in two SQL implementations and income eligibility remains repeated across three execution paths.

placement.why: Budget policy and method registration remain in their established server modules, although tag recognition belongs behind the existing shared tag abstraction.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested month-wide actions, their tests, method registration and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared argument type and average wrappers simplify ownership, but parallel eligibility implementations require coordinated updates whenever the policy changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts uses FIXED_COST_TAG_REGEX instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText, while copyPreviousMonth and setZero implement eligibility outside forEachMonthWideCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions expresses hidden, template and fixed-group eligibility as exclusions, while getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage reshapes the same policy into inclusion predicates.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories adds a policy parameter with conditional SQL in both selection helpers; copyPreviousMonth and setZero bypass the shared month-wide iterator and retain separate income checks.
